interpretationPolicy: The supplied names and researched pages are used only to distill broad semantic, silhouette, material, and behavior cues. Every rendered design, atlas, cube, plane, pivot, hierarchy, UV layout, marking, proportion, and animation is a fresh clean-room interpretation. No Witchery, Bewitchment, vanilla, or third-party model, texture, ornament layout, code, or geometry is reproduced or imitated.
